text: CloudWay 24 offers exclusive lounge access for our premium guests, ensuring a comfortable and luxurious pre-flight experience at our main hubs and select international airports. Lounge access is designed to match the level of cabin class you travel in, offering everything from gourmet dining and private workspaces to shower facilities and entertainment.

- Access: Complimentary
- Guest Policy: 1 complimentary guest
- Lounge Features:
  - Private suites
  - À la carte gourmet dining
  - Premium beverages & barista service
  - Spa and shower facilities
  - Private meeting rooms
  - High-speed Wi-Fi
  - Entertainment lounge
path: CloudWay 24 Lounge Access Guide > Lounge Access by Cabin Class > 1. CloudLux (First Class)

text:
